_comment: Savings of one won bet, per chore (docs/discovery/product-concept.md, Chore catalogue). 'sourced' figures link their source; the rest are labelled 'typical estimate'. Time counts skipped steps only: hanging laundry instead of the dryer is 0 minutes. The four city rain bets (REQ-030) are loaded by the app only; the backtest reads the first five chores.

plants.assumption: 5 balcony pots: about 4 L of watering and 5 min skipped

heat-pump.assumption: vs a heat-pump dryer, ~2.2 kWh per load; no minutes saved

condenser.assumption: vs a condenser dryer, ~3.5 kWh per load; no minutes saved

vented.assumption: vs a vented dryer, ~5.3 kWh per load; no minutes saved

none.assumption: no dryer in your baseline, so no electricity saved and no minutes

laundry_tonight.assumption: about 10 min of bringing laundry in and ~1.5 kWh of rack or dryer skipped

ac.assumption: ~2.5 kWh of air conditioning per evening skipped, no minutes

heater.assumption: ~3.5 kWh of heating per day skipped, no minutes

car_rinse.assumption: a car wash skipped: about 40 min and 75 L of water, the lower end of a car wash (75 to 300 L)

bike_rinse.assumption: a bike rinse skipped: about 10 min and 20 L of water

terrace_rinse.assumption: a terrace and furniture hose-down skipped: about 15 min and 30 L of water

rain_fill.assumption: a rain barrel or bird bath top-up skipped: about 5 min and 20 L of tap water
